asset.description: Plant/asset involved, where the NCR is a plant non-conformance.

creator_name.description: Display name of the submitting Assignar user (free text, not a resolved identity).

external_id.description: Stable identity of the source NCR record (Assignar form-result id, cast to text).

financial_period.description: The period the NCR falls in, derived from `occurred_at`; the axis retention is computed against.

form_id.description: The source form template the NCR was captured on.

form_title.description: The source form template's title — which tenant NCR template this is, and whether it is the quality or safety variant.

jurisdiction.description: The WHS/quality regime whose notification and retention rules apply to this record.

modified_time.description: Source last-modified time; the delta-harvest cursor.

narrative.description: The non-conformance description and what was done, composed from the source responses Q&A; may be null when nothing is renderable.

occurred_at.description: When the non-conformance was submitted/occurred; the reporting clock.

worker.description: Worker who raised or is responsible for the NCR; resolves to the worker spine.
